title: Business Rules — Create / Edit
overviewHtml: A business rule: conditions and actions that run automatically when something happens to a record, written either visually (if / then / else blocks) or as a formula. A rule is built on a base object — Employee, Employee Absence, or Workflow Routing — which decides the fields it can read and set. On Employee and Employee Absence, rules run before a record is saved (setting values first, then validating) and before it is deleted; a rule can raise an error that stops the save. On Workflow Routing, a rule can name the approval chain a request uses, ahead of workflow groups. A rule runs only while it is active and today falls between its effective dates, and only through an assignment that is active for the event; assignments on the same event run in execution order. Use Run test to try a rule before saving it.
